title: Revised Code of Washington, Title 80 (Public Utilities), Chapter 80.28 - Gas, Electrical, and Water Companies
verified_how: fetched https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=80.28 (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Home / State laws and rules / RCWs / Title 80 / Chapter 80.28', heading 'Chapter 80.28 RCW - GAS, ELECTRICAL, AND WATER COMPANIES', with 'Complete chapter' HTML and PDF links, an 'RCW dispositions' link and a full section list. Currency: the RCW index page (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/) states 'Last update: July 15, 2026' and explains that 'The online version of the RCW is updated twice a year, once in the early fall following the legislative session, and again at the end of the year if a ballot measure that changes the law passed at the general election'; it also records that 'The Statute Law Committee declares that the certified PDF publication documents in the RCW Archive area on the Office of the Code Reviser's website constitute the official publication of the Revised Code of Washington', so this HTML version is the working rather than the certified text. The register flags amended-but-not-yet-merged text by printing a section two or three times with '(as amended by 2026 c NN)' suffixes.
notes: This is the rates-and-service chapter for investor-owned gas, electric and water utilities regulated by the Utilities and Transportation Commission. Consumer-owned utilities (municipal utilities under Title 35 RCW, public utility districts under Title 54 RCW, and electric cooperatives under chapter 23.86 RCW) are outside UTC rate jurisdiction, so this chapter does not reach all Washington ratepayers. Billing, deposit, arrears and disconnection detail is UTC regulation (WAC 480-100 and 480-90) rather than statute.
